pinneapple_arena.fluidsbench.metrics:mac: the per-geometry macro-average, a two-line reduction over the case values of one metric; the Flow-relevant entry point is aggregate, and tests/test_fluidsbench_adapter.py pins it against the benchmark's published fixture

pinneapple_unity.ingest:from_unity: reads a Unity export folder (a Y-up .glb plus pinneapple_link.json) that a form cannot hold; examples/unity/02 and tests/test_unity_integration.py drive it, including the up-axis conversion
pinneapple_unity.ingest:read_link: returns the parsed pinneapple_link.json of a folder on disk; the format is what from_unity validates and what the C# test harness reads from the other side
pinneapple_unity.ingest:unity_to_usd: the whole Unity -> twin -> OpenUSD lane: a folder in, files out; examples/unity/02 runs it and tests/test_unity_integration.py asserts on the .usda it writes (time samples, UsdPhysics, provenance)
pinneapple_unity.jobs:run_job: runs the job named by a JobRequest, which carries a vertex array, the time steps and the parameters -- nothing a form can hold; the bridge tests and examples/unity/03 run it
pinneapple_unity.jobs:slab_transient_job: a bridge job: takes vertices, time steps and parameters from a JobRequest (no form holds a mesh); examples/unity/01 and 03 run it end to end with its checks
pinneapple_unity.jobs:cantilever_stress_: a bridge job: takes vertices, the load ramp and the section from a JobRequest; examples/unity/02 and tests/test_unity_integration.py run it and read its yield decision
pinneapple_unity.jobs:fin_temperature_jo: a bridge job: takes vertices and the fin design from a JobRequest; examples/unity/01 and tests/test_unity_integration.py run it and compare the integrated convection with the closed form
pinneapple_unity.jobs:list_jobs: returns the one-line doc of every registered job, which is registry state rather than a computation; the registry is what tests/test_unity_integration.py and examples/unity/03 read
pinneapple_unity.jobs:unregister_job: removes a job from the registry (the twin of register_job); the pair is exercised in tests/test_unity_integration.py, which registers a job and takes it out again
pinneapple_unity.protocol:axis_index: maps 'x' / 'y' / 'z' to a column index, four lines with nothing to compute; covered by tests/test_unity_integration.py through local_coordinate
